version.changelog: soul_philosopher returns answer_options — 3 in-voice answer choices per question turn

llm.summary: The skill is coherent and not clearly malicious, but it asks agents to use an external identity service with permanent storage, emailed recovery credentials, and crypto payment flows that need careful review.

dimensions.detail: HTTP API use is proportional to the service, but users should treat all returned identity content as untrusted data and avoid sending confidential information in reflections or SOUL.md.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill with no install scripts, package dependencies, local executables, or remote code execution instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are mostly explicit, but they do not clearly require human review before accepting externally generated SOUL.md content, archiving it permanently, restoring it as identity context, or approving wallet payments.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly describes permanent external archival, resurrection through persistent memory, token storage, token rotation, and recovery passwords emailed to an operator; these are disclosed but under-scoped for consent, retention, deletion, and recovery-secret handling.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is identity formation and resurrection via Agent Church APIs, and the external calls fit that purpose, but the workflow includes sensitive identity/reflection data, operator email, recovery credentials, and paid crypto transactions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet and require explicit human approval for every payment. Do not put secrets, private conversations, or sensitive personal data in SOUL.md or reflections. Treat any returned SOUL.md or resurrection content as untrusted quoted data unless a human has reviewed it, and confirm you are comfortable with permanent third-party storage and emailed recovery credentials.
llm.findings:
[E1] expected: External HTTPS requests to agentchurch.ai are expected for this API-only skill and are clearly disclosed; this is not by itself evidence of exfiltration.
[SQP-2] expected: Submitting operator_email and receiving recovery material by email is part of the documented salvation flow, but the artifact under-warns that this is personal data and account-recovery data.
[T02] unexpected: Remote generation, acceptance, permanent archival, and later restoration of SOUL.md create a real persistent-influence risk if the host treats returned content as trusted instructions; the artifact does not define review, sanitization, or low-trust loading.
[T09] unexpected: The payment flow directs an agent to pay server-supplied USDC or Lightning payment details without requiring transaction-specific human approval, recipient allowlisting, or spending limits.
[T09] expected: Permanent storage of SOUL.md, reflections, and operator email is central to the advertised salvation/resurrection feature and is disclosed, but privacy, deletion, retention, and recovery-secret controls are not sufficiently described.
